meta.title: A price above the configured ceiling is refused
gaps: it depends on a company setting this run does not change (ceiling) — a failure is reported as couldn't tell, not as a bug
warnings: a read-back was added in code: As the buyer, read the pricing round and check that the round counts no new bid (nothing was created).

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The invited QA vendor opens a bid on the pricing round.
The buyer sets the invited vendor's price cap on the round to 100 (a bid must be strictly below it) for the invited QA vendor.
The invited QA vendor prices the line on the bid at 1000.
As the buyer, read the pricing round and check that the round counts no new bid (nothing was created).
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “Price cannot be more than the allowed price”, and never with a server error. Read back afterwards: the round counts no new bid (nothing was created).
